functionDeclarations.name: get_screen_state
functionDeclarations.description: Inspects the current foreground Android screen and returns visible interactive elements, labels, and package name.

functionDeclarations.name: tap_element
functionDeclarations.description: Taps an element on the screen by its unique numeric element ID.

element_id.description: The unique integer ID of the element to tap

functionDeclarations.name: scroll_screen
functionDeclarations.description: Scrolls the current screen forward (down) or backward (up).

functionDeclarations.name: press_system_button
functionDeclarations.description: Presses an Android system navigation button: 'BACK', 'HOME', or 'RECENTS'.

functionDeclarations.name: open_app
functionDeclarations.description: Launches an application by package name or common app name.

package_name.description: The application package name or name to launch

functionDeclarations.name: open_settings_page
functionDeclarations.description: Opens a specific Android system settings page.

functionDeclarations.name: request_confirmation
functionDeclarations.description: Explicitly requests user confirmation via the high-contrast green tick / red cross overlay before high-stakes actions.

reason.description: Brief explanation of why confirmation is requested

functionDeclarations.name: request_human_help
functionDeclarations.description: Hands off control to a human helper when a sensitive financial app, password, OTP, or unresolvable screen is encountered.

functionDeclarations.name: finish_task
functionDeclarations.description: Signals that the user's requested voice task has been successfully completed or ended.
